title: Nokia Design Archive (2025)
summary: Aalto University has created a comprehensive digital archive preserving Nokia's industrial design heritage, documenting the iconic Finnish mobile phone designs and corporate design philosophy from the company's history. The archive serves as an academic resource for studying industrial design evolution and Nordic design traditions.
problem_solved: Preserves and makes accessible Nokia's historical design legacy before it becomes lost to time.
why_valuable: Provides researchers and designers access to a rich catalog of industrial design history that shaped the mobile phone industry and Nordic design aesthetics.
